ex.s: Hear the music of voices, the song of a bird, the mighty strains of an orchestra, as if you would be stricken deaf tomorrow.
ex.t: 聆听人声的音乐、鸟儿的歌唱、管弦乐雄壮的乐章，仿佛明天你就会失聪。

ex.s: I have often thought that if everyone became blind and deaf for a few days at some time when they are young, it would be a good thing.
ex.t: 我常想，如果每个人在年轻时的某段时间都能失明失聪几天，那将是好事。

ex.s: Yes, I am deaf, that is the way I am made.
ex.t: 是的，我耳聋，我生来如此。

ex.s: During this same period, he slowly became deaf.
ex.t: 在同一时期，他逐渐失聪。

defs.def: people who cannot hear 耳聋的人；聋子

ex.s: By translating the rich and humourous text of Love’s Labour’s Lost into the physical language of BSL, Deafinitely Theatre creates a new interpretation of Shakespeare’s comedy and aims to build a bridge between deaf and hearing worlds by performing to both groups as one audience.
ex.t: 通过将《爱的徒劳》丰富幽默的文本翻译成BSL的肢体语言，Deafinitely剧院创造了莎士比亚喜剧的新诠释，旨在通过向聋人和听人作为同一观众表演，在聋人与听人世界间架起桥梁。

defs.def: not willing to listen or pay attention to sth 不愿听；不去注意

ex.s: My parents urged me to get out of this so-called unhealthy habit, but their repeated requests fell on deaf ears.
ex.t: 父母催促我改掉这个所谓不健康的习惯，但他们反复的劝说我充耳不闻。
